children: Motilal Oswal's research report on TCI Express

TCI Express’s (TCIE) 2QFY27 revenue grew 9% YoY to INR3.3b (in line). EBITDA stood at INR396m (+12% YoY), 4% above our estimate. EBITDA margin came in at 11.8% in 2QFY27 vs. our estimate of 11.6%. APAT rose ~6% YoY to INR267m (in line). Volumes grew 6% YoY to 0.265m tons. TCIE reported a steady performance in 2QFY27, backed by healthy surface segment growth, which was driven by higher yields and increased business from large enterprises. Management targets volume growth of 11-12% in 2HFY27 as it expects further improvement in SME demand to drive a recovery in overall demand. We broadly retain our FY27 and FY28 estimates and expect TCIE to deliver a CAGR of 6%/8%/11% in volume/revenue/EBITDA
over FY26-28. We reiterate our Neutral rating with a TP of INR530, based on 18x FY28E EPS.
